source: Department of Health and Social Care, Adult social care finance report, England: 2024 to 2025, Table 14; Department of Health and Social Care, Adult social care activity report, England: 2024 to 2025, Table 34; Office for National Statistics, Mid-Year Population Estimates, England and Wales, June 2025, for the per-head rates
methodology: Gross spend per adult = gross current expenditure (finance report, total, GBP thousands) x 1,000 / ONS mid-2025 residents aged 18 and over. Residential rate = clients aged 65 and over in residential long term support during the year (activity report) / ONS mid-2025 residents aged 65 and over x 10,000. Mid-2025 populations come from population-estimates.json; a county's is the sum of its districts.
populationSource: Office for National Statistics, Mid-Year Population Estimates, England and Wales, June 2025, tables MYE0, MYE2 (persons), MYE3, MYE4, MYE6, MYE7. The data tables in this spreadsheet were originally published at 9.30am 29 July 2026.
caveat: Adult social care is run by upper tier councils (counties, unitaries, metropolitan districts and London boroughs), so a district shows its county's figures. Spend reflects age structure, deprivation and unpaid care, so differences between councils are not a measure of efficiency. Activity figures are official statistics in development.
